dedupe_keys.name: multi family residential building hourly energy and indoor environmental quality monitoring bolzano area 2006 2009

description: This dataset holds three years of hourly monitoring from a multi-family residential building in the Bolzano area of South Tyrol, Italy, in an Alpine climate, combining energy use with indoor environmental quality indicators such as CO2 concentration and with weather variables. It was published on Zenodo on 9 May 2026 (version 1.0.0) by Marco Castagna of Eurac Research. It covers 1 July 2006 to 21 July 2009. Temperature profiles are averages over eight selected apartments and energy use is aggregated for the same apartments; the data are released as monitored, without outlier removal, smoothing or gap filling, and anomalous values and unusual operating trends are deliberately kept. Coverage: one building. Access: one CSV of about 1 MB on Zenodo, with a variable table giving units and ranges. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: raw data with anomalies, and averaged apartment temperatures. Simulation uses: benchmarking anomaly detection, fault detection and diagnostics and data quality tools, and calibrating residential energy models. Related records: the HEART Bagnolo in Piano monitoring data and the Eurac baseline building models.
name: Multi-family residential building: hourly energy and indoor environmental quality monitoring, Bolzano area (2006-2009)
